# attestation interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestationInterval`](gmeow-attestationInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestationInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)

The time interval over which the attested usage is asserted to have been observed — e.g. a corpus span, an inscription period, or a community usage era. A relator carries its period this way rather than via statement-level [`validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil alone.
